notes.title: UPDATE: Performance improvements, invert option, and more!
notes.notes:
We just pushed a well needed update with huge performance improvements and new features!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29244093/1fd02b35729bf9b5aefa7b3a0f34f3c09db83d60.jpg

New Features:

Invert Y-axis option. It can be toggled on/off from the in-game pause menu.

Dynamic narration audio. Narration volume should now adjust based on music and location. Previously, the music would drown out the narration; this is now fixed.

Changes:

Drastic performance improvements.

Optimized texture streaming for less texture pop-in.

Fixed windowed mode not correctly displaying game name.

Fixed an out of bounds glitch in chapter 3.

Improved culling of foliage and level streaming for better performance. 

Reduced file size to 5gb. Nearly half of what it was!

Known Issues:

Unfortunately, you may still experience some slight texture pop-in if you are running at 4k resolution. This is something we are looking into. It is caused by lack of v-ram, so if your card has less than 4gb of v-ram, we recommend you don't run at 4k to avoid this issue.

LOD pop-in is still being improved. In the next update, this should be completely fixed.


Let us know if you come across anymore issues! Also, we have a BIG ANNOUNCEMENT about the game coming later this week. Have fun!
